build_data_provider: build a data provider that shards CIFAR10 into federated learning users with configurable examples per user
create_dataloader: create a federated learning data loader that shards and batchifies vision datasets for training eval and test
create_userdata: create a user data object that splits batches into train and eval sets with a configurable eval split ratio
build_simpleconvnet: build a simple convolutional neural network with group normalization and configurable dropout for image classification
create_metrics_reporter: create a metrics reporter that computes accuracy scores and compares current eval metrics against best metrics
